title: AutoHost Mini
description: AutoHost Mini, on creating a new world, starts players off inside a stronghold, making the underground your world’s first home.
body:
AutoHost Mini transforms how Minecraft worlds begin by spawning players inside a stronghold instead of on the surface. When the world is first created, the mod locates the nearest stronghold and, once its structure is generated, places the player inside, prioritizing jail cells, libraries, portal rooms, or any safe corridor inside the fortress. This creates a unique “wake up in the dungeon” start that instantly anchors the gameplay. The mod sets both world spawn and players respawn inside the stronghold, ensuring deaths return you unless you make a bed. Additional players joining the world will automatically spawn in the same dungeon area, making the experience consistent for multiplayer.

If no suitable interior can be found, the mod falls back to spawning players on the surface above the stronghold. AutoHost Mini is a light-weight and simple way to create a grounded-heavy world where your base, respawn point, and End portal are all immediately within reach.
